rationale: Eight brokers cut Kering targets citing Gucci's 5% comparable revenue decline as the drag ahead of Q3 results.
RBC's second target cut in weeks forecasts Gucci dragging Kering's Q3 with a 5% organic sales decline.
Consultant and analysts explicitly criticize 'Made in China' sneaker as undermining Gucci's luxury/provenance positioning amid steep sales decline.
Italian trade press factually reports the sneaker being made in China and breaking the 'Made in Italy' norm without its own evaluative verdict.
Factual market-intel on Chinese Golden Week travel/spend to Europe, relevant context but not a judgment on Gucci.
Baseline third-party SNS analytics snapshot, explicitly not a reaction to any specific content.
Resale listings showing up to 70% discount to retail signal resale-value erosion, though presented as data not editorial verdict.
Recurring Trustpilot complaints about product quality failures and poor customer service, with reviewers feeling they pay for the name not quality.
